security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown code formatting, documentation links, and CSS class regex patterns. The real risks are operational: the included migration shell script installs packages, rewrites project files, removes old config, and creates a hidden backup directory. No evidence found of prompt injection, credential exfiltration, malicious network callbacks, or covert data collection.

remediation.issue: Migration script performs package installs and file rewrites.
remediation.suggestion: Add a dry-run mode, explicit confirmation prompts, and clear instructions to review version control diffs before running it.

remediation.issue: Hidden backup directory is created in the target project.
remediation.suggestion: Document the backup path before execution or let users choose a visible backup directory.

remediation.issue: Status messages use unquoted file variables with basename.
remediation.suggestion: Use basename -- "$file" to handle spaces, leading dashes, and unusual filenames safely.

content.value_statement: Tailwind CSS V4 changes configuration, utilities, browser support, and performance expectations. This skill gives structured migration, component, and optimization guidance for modern frontend teams.
actual_capabilities: Explains Tailwind CSS V4 CSS-first configuration and @theme patterns.
Guides migrations from Tailwind v3 utility names and config files.
Designs reusable component systems with Tailwind V4 layers and variables.
Recommends build tool integration for Vite, PostCSS, Webpack, and CLI workflows.
Diagnoses common V4 issues such as removed opacity utilities and changed defaults.
limitations: It does not replace official Tailwind release notes for newly released features.
The included shell script can modify project files and should be reviewed before use.
It focuses on Tailwind V4, not general JavaScript or framework architecture.
Legacy browser support advice is limited because Tailwind V4 targets modern browsers.

use_cases.title: Migrate a Product UI
use_cases.description: Plan and execute a Tailwind v3 to v4 migration with utility replacements and validation checks.

use_cases.title: Design a Component System
use_cases.description: Create theme variables, component classes, and state conventions for reusable Tailwind V4 interfaces.

use_cases.title: Improve Build Performance
use_cases.description: Choose the right Tailwind V4 plugin and reduce unnecessary theme or breakpoint configuration.

prompt_templates.title: Check My Setup
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner validation of a new Tailwind V4 project.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Tailwind CSS V4 setup and tell me if my @import, plugin, and @theme usage are correct.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Migration
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate Tailwind v3 to v4 upgrade planning.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Tailwind v3 to v4 migration plan for my project, including utility renames, config changes, and validation steps.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Theme System
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a Tailwind V4 theme system with CSS variables, component classes, dark mode, and brand overrides.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize a Large App
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced performance tuning for a production frontend.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit my Tailwind V4 build strategy and recommend changes for faster builds, smaller CSS, and better HMR.

output_examples.input: I need to migrate our dashboard from Tailwind v3 to v4.
output: A phased migration checklist covering dependencies, CSS imports, @theme conversion, and renamed utilities.
A risk list for visual regressions such as borders, ring widths, and opacity utilities.
A validation plan for responsive layouts, dark mode, and build output size.

output_examples.input: Help me create a reusable button and card system in Tailwind V4.
output: A token plan for colors, spacing, typography, and component states.
A component class strategy that separates base styles, variants, and disabled states.
Guidance on when to use utilities directly instead of extracting components.

output_examples.input: My Tailwind build is slower than expected after upgrading.
output: A plugin selection review based on the project build tool.
Checks for excessive @theme variables, unused breakpoints, and source map settings.
A measurement plan for build time, hot reload time, and final CSS size.

best_practices: Review migration diffs before running automated scripts on production projects.
Keep @theme blocks focused on values that differ from Tailwind defaults.
Test visual changes across responsive, dark mode, and interactive component states.
anti_patterns: Do not assume tailwind.config.js controls Tailwind V4 output by default.
Do not define large theme scales that your application never uses.
Do not run migration scripts without version control or a separate backup.

faq.question: Does this skill help with Tailwind v3 projects?
faq.answer: It mainly helps migrate from v3 to v4. For ongoing v3 work, use general Tailwind guidance.

faq.question: Can it generate component systems?
faq.answer: Yes. It can outline tokens, theme variables, component classes, variants, and validation steps.

faq.question: Does it require running the included script?
faq.answer: No. The script is optional and should be reviewed before it changes project files.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Can it optimize Tailwind build speed?
faq.answer: Yes. It recommends plugin choices, theme simplification, source map settings, and measurement checks.

faq.question: Does it cover browser compatibility?
faq.answer: Yes. It highlights modern browser requirements and when legacy support may require Tailwind v3.
